label: Wistia
description: Manage Wistia media, folders, tags and captions; import videos and read statistics

operations.name: get_account
operations.description: Get the current account's name, URL and record counts.

operations.name: get_token
operations.description: Inspect the current token's permissions without returning its secret value.

operations.name: list_media
operations.description: List or find media by exact name, folder, type or archive status.

operations.name: get_media
operations.description: Fetch a media's metadata and processing status.

operations.name: update_media
operations.description: Update media metadata. Supplied tags replace all existing tags.

operations.name: delete_media
operations.description: Move a media to Recently Deleted; this does not prove permanent purging.

operations.name: copy_media
operations.description: Copy media and assets. Wistia may fall back to the original folder if the target is invalid.

operations.name: get_media_stats
operations.description: Read aggregated embed statistics for a media.

operations.name: import_media
operations.description: Queue a media import from a publicly accessible URL; poll the returned job separately.

operations.name: get_job
operations.description: Read the status of a background import or other asynchronous job.

operations.name: list_folders
operations.description: List folders in the connected account.

operations.name: get_folder
operations.description: Read a folder and its media link without following the link.

operations.name: create_folder
operations.description: Create a private folder with anonymous uploads and downloads disabled.

operations.name: update_folder
operations.description: Update a folder name or description without changing its sharing settings.

operations.name: delete_folder
operations.description: Delete a folder AND all media inside it.

operations.name: list_tags
operations.description: List account tags and their usage counts.

operations.name: create_tag
operations.description: Create a tag; Wistia lowercases and normalizes whitespace in the name.

operations.name: delete_tag
operations.description: Delete an account tag by its name.

operations.name: list_captions
operations.description: List the caption tracks on a media.

operations.name: create_captions
operations.description: Create captions from SRT text; omit language to let Wistia detect it.

operations.name: on_new_media
operations.description:
Watch new media; the first poll records existing media without firing.

    Monitors up to 2,000 media per scope; choose a folder for larger libraries.

operations.name: on_updated_media
operations.description:
Watch new or updated media, including processing and metadata changes.

    The first poll records existing versions without firing. Monitors up to
    2,000 media per scope; choose a folder for larger libraries.
